operation_proposals.source_operation: Cell-specific edge-weight product combining two normalized expression values with a reference PPI interaction weight.
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog has normalization, projection, and addition, but no documented element-wise multiplication/product operation.

operation_proposals.source_operation: GIN weighted-neighbor aggregation and MLP message passing over graph nodes and edge features.
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog has no graph convolution, neighborhood aggregation, GIN, or generic message-passing primitive.

operation_proposals.source_operation: VGAE construction of Gaussian latent parameters and reparameterized latent-variable sampling.
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The sampling primitive can consume a documented distribution, but the catalog has no operation for constructing the distribution from mean, log-standard-deviation, and standard-normal noise.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Decoder inner product followed by sigmoid conversion to an edge probability.
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog has no inner-product or sigmoid-scoring operation.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Gradient-based fine-tuning of pretrained Shusi parameters on AML graphs.
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: Indexed state update is position-based replacement, while the paper describes optimizer-based parameter adaptation.
